ar_functional_knn.name: ar_functional_knn
ar_functional_knn.description: Similarity-weighted mean residual response of the k training perturbations whose target genes share the most gene sets with p's target, zero when no set is shared.

ar_target_knn.name: ar_target_knn
ar_target_knn.description: Similarity-weighted mean of training responses: weights training perturbations by coexpression, shared gene sets and PPI between their target genes and p's target, plus the target gene's control expression and mean response.

ar_ppi_jac3d.name: ar_ppi_jac3d
ar_ppi_jac3d.description: Direct PPI, second-hop PPI and PPI-neighbourhood Jaccard weighted mean responses, each leaving p out, with the gene-set-Jaccard weighted mean as fallback, as three columns.

ar_tgt_ctl_x.name: ar_tgt_ctl_x
ar_tgt_ctl_x.description: Target gene mean control expression on the target's own row, zero elsewhere (is_target times control mean).
